opb. Immobilize the knee with a bandage for 15 days and give non-steroidal anti-inflammatories.
opc. Practice an arthrocentesis to perform culture, analysis of microcrystals and cellular counting of the synovial fluid.
opd. Perform an arthroscopy.
ope. It is a gouty arthritis, I would start treatment with allopurinol.
